```
import boto3

def deploy_static_website(bucket_name, region):
    s3 = boto3.client('s3', region_name=region)
    s3.upload_file('index.html', bucket_name, 'index.html')
    s3.upload_file('style.css', bucket_name, 'style.css')
    website_config = {
        'IndexDocument': 'index.html',
        'ErrorDocument': 'index.html'
    }
    s3.put_bucket_website_configuration(Bucket=bucket_name, WebsiteConfiguration=website_config)

bucket_name = 'my-static-website'
region = 'us-west-2'
deploy_static_website(bucket_name, region)
```
Note that you'll need to replace `my-static-website` with your actual bucket name, and `us-west-2` with your actual region. Also, make sure you have the necessary credentials set up to use the AWS SDK.
